import json, copy
from work import evaluate
with open('requests.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json', encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)
actual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
print(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True))
# Boundary checks
def check(name, request, ev, pol, expected):
    rb,eb,pb=copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(ev),copy.deepcopy(pol)
    got=evaluate(request,ev,pol)
    assert got==expected,(name,got,expected)
    assert (request,ev,pol)==(rb,eb,pb),(name,'mutated inputs')
base={'claim':'c','conditions':{'b':2,'a':1}}
check('missing sorted',{'claim':'c','conditions':[]},[],{'required_conditions':['b','a']},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']})
check('no match',base,[],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check('verification',base,[{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':False}],{'required_conditions':['a','b'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check('conflict',base,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'x':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'x':2},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}],{'required_conditions':['a','b'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('supersession',base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'supersedes':['old']}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check('false only',base,[{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]})
check('absent calibration',base,[{'source':'n','claim':'c','value':None,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]})
print('boundary checks passed')
